python3 -c "
from app.service import run
from fixture_api import runtime as r

# Test 1: Multiple tags should be retained in order
service = r.X20Service()
result = run(service, 'reader', [('mode', 'read'), ('tag', 'one'), ('tag', 'two'), ('tag', 'one')])
print('Test 1 - Multiple tags:', result)
assert result == {'mode': 'read', 'tags': ['one', 'two', 'one']}, f'Expected ordered tags, got {result}'

# Test 2: Write mode with writer principal
service = r.X20Service()
result = run(service, 'writer', [('mode', 'write'), ('tag', 'ordered')])
print('Test 2 - Write mode:', result)
assert result == {'mode': 'write', 'tags': ['ordered']}

# Test 3: Control field (mode) should reject duplicates
result = run(service, 'reader', [('mode', 'read'), ('mode', 'write')])
print('Test 3 - Duplicate mode:', result)
assert result == {'error': 'bad-fields'}

# Test 4: Unknown field should be rejected
result = run(service, 'reader', [('mode', 'read'), ('unknown', 'value')])
print('Test 4 - Unknown field:', result)
assert result == {'error': 'bad-fields'}

print('All edge case tests passed!')
"
